[SWS_DM_02176] Response body of a synchronous
operation start
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04262
⌈
If a synchronous SOVD
operation
has been started, the DM shall return the SOVD
response body according to ASAM SOVD[5][14] and set the parameters
attribute
to the value derived from the
DiagnosticSovdContentData
within the returned
StartSynchronousExecutionResponse
from
ara::diag::GenericDiagnos-
ticSovdOperation::StartExecution
.
⌋
